propositions: Cancelled ACLI link delete failures are incorrectly counted as applied links due to exception handler at dispatch_one.py:778-789 incrementing _links_applied in the CalledProcessError path, causing batch_outcome to report error=None with nonzero links_applied for deterministic permanent failures

Missing --yes flag on acli link create and link delete subcommands causes stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL to read EOF at confirmation prompt, triggering 'X Error: command cancelled' exit, which recurs identically every pass due to deterministic root cause not transient race

Idempotent failure detection must check both stderr and stdout for 404/409/not-found markers to properly classify concurrent-removal races, mirroring delete_issue precedent at acli.py:739-742, not stderr-only inspection

Silent-divergence canary REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP cannot fire on cancelled deletes because exception handler artificially inflates links_applied to equal computed, breaking the computed>0 and applied==0 detection gate
New _links_failed counter must be threaded through _update_one_dispatch_links return tuple, apply_handlers.py subop dict, and batch_outcome line to surface non-idempotent failures for observability
Code extraction of _dispatch_link_removes into dispatch_apply_phases.py to comply with 800-LOC and C901 complexity ceilings after narrowed idempotent arm is added
